name: CheXpert
description: A large chest radiograph dataset for training and evaluating machine-learning models for the diagnosis of 14 observations from chest X-rays, with uncertainty labels and radiologist-labeled validation data.
citation: Irvin, J., Rajpurkar, P., Ko, M., et al. (2019). CheXpert: A Large Chest Radiograph Dataset with Uncertainty Labels and Expert Comparison. Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 33(01), 590-597. https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v33i01.3301590
